name: Erdős-Selfridge function: a(n) is the least number m > n+1 such that the least prime factor of binomial(m, n) is > n.
reference: N. J. A. Sloane and Simon Plouffe, The Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences, Academic Press, 1995 (includes this sequence).

mathematica: f[n_] := Block[{k = n + 2, p = Table[Prime[i], {i, 1, PrimePi[n]}]}, While[ First[ Sort[ Mod[ Binomial[k, n], p]]] == 0, k++ ]; k]; Table[ f[n], {n, 1, 40}]
program: (PARI) a(n) = local(m,i,f); m=0; i=n+1; while(m<=n,i=i+1; m=factor(binomial(i,n))[1,1]); i /* _Ralf Stephan_ */
